testcase.name: 1. authority write advances revision and list/inspector reflect new state
2. offline degradation shows banner with preserved capabilities
3. partial strategy degradation labels unavailable strategy names
4. stale snapshot preserved and labeled when authority revision advances
5. write conflict (base revision mismatch) rolls back optimistic state
6. malformed DTO response triggers rejection without crash
7. request deadline triggers AbortError and timeout list state
8. layout worker failure falls back to complete list view
9. renderer context loss shows fallback and preserves list completeness
10. delete removes item from list and inspector shows zero residue
11. Recovery_Mode shows diagnostics and blocks all write operations
12. patchReducer: duplicate patch, reorder, gap are all no-ops
13. refetch triggered when patch has gap (recovery_cursor used)
14. inspector renders seven independent sections without cross-contamination
